apps.name: Fuentes Archive
apps.subtitle: New videos from the Rumble Videos tab
apps.localizedDescription: Watches https://rumble.com/c/nickjfuentes/videos and saves new public uploads into the Files app. Shorts, livestreams, and the All tab are not downloaded. No App Store account and no paid signing entitlements.

versions.localizedDescription: Audio plays through the silent switch and on the lock screen. New Player tab lists finished downloads, with resume, speed, and 15-second skip.

Downloads prefer a single progressive MP4. HLS is only the fallback and runs up to 8 pieces at once. File sizes come from Rumble's format metadata instead of the playlist. Settings includes a debug log.
Tap a video for download options (every quality or audio-only, with file sizes). New Downloads tab with pause, resume, stop, and Pause All.

appPermissions.usageDescription: Optional. Copies a finished download into Photos when that setting is on. The file is always kept in the Files app.
